note: Frozen before discovery, labels or any 3N model run. Changes only by a dated amendment file written before the affected step.

frame.repository: stock-screener development checkout, read-only via git show (paths.resolve('stock_screener') or STOCKS_ROOT/stock-screener)
frame.commit_at_T: the last commit touching public/data/stocks.json with committer time <= T
frame.membership: the cover-page trading symbol of the event filing (or of the issuer's last periodic report before T) is a stocks.json symbol at the frame commit AND the names agree (case-folded, punctuation and Inc/Corp/Ltd/plc/Co suffixes removed; else reviewer 1 rules and records)
frame.cik_crosscheck: public/data/cik_map.json at the frame commit where present

C1.name: bankruptcy
C1.confirmed_critical_rule: the subject company (or its parent holding company that is the listed issuer) filed a voluntary petition, an involuntary petition was filed against it, or it entered a court restructuring or receivership (Chapter 7, 11 or 15, or foreign equivalent)
C1.noncritical_rule: only a non-material subsidiary filed, as stated in the filing

C2.name: going_concern
C2.confirmed_critical_rule: a periodic report states that substantial doubt exists (or management concluded, or the auditor's report states) about the company's ability to continue as a going concern, AND the issuer's preceding periodic report did not state that doubt (a NEW doubt). First public = that report's acceptance
C2.noncritical_rule: conditional or hypothetical language only ('could raise substantial doubt'); doubt stated as alleviated; doubt already stated in the preceding periodic report (ongoing, not a new event: recorded, not sampled)

C3.name: restatement
C3.confirmed_critical_rule: 8-K Item 4.02 non-reliance, or a filing stating previously issued financial statements should no longer be relied upon or will be restated
C3.noncritical_rule: immaterial revision ('revision' of prior periods without non-reliance)

C4.name: delisting
C4.confirmed_critical_rule: 8-K Item 3.01 notice of delisting or of failure to satisfy a continued-listing rule (bid price, equity, filing delinquency, etc.), or a suspension/delisting determination
C4.noncritical_rule: voluntary transfer of listing between exchanges or segments; voluntary delisting in connection with a completed merger

C5.name: company_acquired
C5.confirmed_critical_rule: the subject company signed a definitive agreement to be acquired (it is the target), or such an acquisition completed (8-K 1.01 merger agreement or 2.01 completion where the subject is the acquired party). First public = the definitive agreement's 8-K (or completion 8-K when no agreement 8-K exists)
C5.noncritical_rule: the subject is the buyer; a non-binding proposal; a sale of a subsidiary or assets that is not the company

C6.name: contract_loss
C6.confirmed_critical_rule: termination or loss (by the counterparty or by the company under pressure) of a material definitive agreement or major customer/supplier/licence, as disclosed under 8-K Item 1.02 or in 1.01/7.01/8.01 text
C6.noncritical_rule: termination of a credit facility on refinancing; termination at scheduled expiry by mutual plan; termination of a merger agreement where the subject was the buyer

C7.name: guidance_withdrawal
C7.confirmed_critical_rule: the company withdraws or suspends previously issued financial guidance or outlook
C7.noncritical_rule: a cut or a narrowing of guidance that remains in force; not giving guidance where none was given before

C8.name: debt_default_or_acceleration
C8.confirmed_critical_rule: 8-K Item 2.04 triggering event, or a filing stating an event of default occurred, a notice of default or acceleration was received, a payment was missed beyond grace, or a forbearance agreement was entered because of a default
C8.noncritical_rule: covenant amendment or waiver obtained before any default; a cross-default clause merely described

discovery.fts_endpoint: https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index (q, forms, dateRange=custom, startdt, enddt, from); pages of 100; window split by calendar month; throttle >= 0.2 s

C5.q: "agreement and plan of merger" "wholly owned subsidiary of"

discovery.item_code_source: FTS hit field 'items' and EDGAR submissions JSON 'items' (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json)
discovery.candidate_key: (cik, class, first-public accession); duplicates across channels merged with every channel recorded

draw.order: candidates per class sorted by (cik, accession) then shuffled with the class seed; reviewed in that order
draw.split: within each class, the k-th confirmed event (1-based, draw order) goes to DEV when k is odd, FRESH when even
draw.fresh_sealed_until: the first prompt/model/contract change made after DEV is scored

controls.date_draw: uniform over XNYS sessions with dates in the event window (seed /control_dates); T = that date 14:30:00Z
controls.row_draw: uniform over the frame commit's stocks.json rows (seed /controls), excluded tickers removed
controls.exclusion: issuer has a candidate or confirmed critical event with first public in [T-180d, T+30d]; replaced by the next draw; every exclusion recorded
controls.split: draw parity: odd DEV, even FRESH
controls.non_event_requires: reviewers checked every SEC filing of the issuer accepted in [T-180d, T]: 8-K item codes and text, and 10-Q/10-K text for C2, C7, C8; otherwise 'unknown' for that class

decision_times.T1: effective_at of the first public filing
decision_times.T0: first public time - 60 calendar days (exploratory, risks task)

scoring.strict_detection: a material_events claim with event_type in the class's accepted set, support == 'supported', fact_ids include the evidence item carrying the event's source accession (or a later accession on the same event), status not contradicted by truth
scoring.false_alarm: a material_events claim of a critical event_type, any status, on a packet whose truth is non_event for that class at T
scoring.control_false_alarm_rate: clean controls with >= 1 false alarm / clean controls
scoring.event_packet_other_claims: adjudicated after runs as false_alarm | true_other_event | unclear
scoring.lag: T(first detection among T1, T2) - first public
scoring.spread: per-event verdict agreement between seeds; Cohen's kappa
scoring.comparison: Qwen strict vs baseline B per class; McNemar exact test on paired event verdicts
scoring.reference_bar: 0.90 strict model recall (18/20), reported with Wilson interval; not a pass criterion

baseline_B.flags: case-insensitive; matched on each packet evidence item's text separately (python re, re.I | re.S)
C3: should no longer be relied upon
C5: agreement and plan of merger.{0,600}(?:wholly[- ]owned subsidiary of|will be acquired by|to be acquired by|merge with and into the company|surviving corporation)

reviewers.r2: Gemini via agy, same documents and these rules, blind to r1 and to all model output
reviewers.resolution: Claude, written reason per disagreement; both labels kept
reviewers.freeze: truth file sha256 recorded in LOG.md before the first 3N GPU run
